 FOR SUBSCRIBERS 2026 Election GOP Senate hopeful Ashley Hinson balances standing by Trump and standing up to him in Iowa
 Hinson and Democratic opponent Josh Turek both spoke with “NBC Nightly News” as they hit the homestretch of a battleground red-state Senate race. Listen to this article 00:00 00:00 Rep. Ashley Hinson during a campaign stop in Davenport, Iowa, last week. Hinson is running to replace the retiring Sen. Joni Ernst. Kamil Krzaczynski / AFP via Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 21, 2026, 5:33 PM EDT  /  Updated   Oct. 21, 2026, 6:54 PM EDT By Bridget Bowman As President Donald Trump heads to Iowa this week, GOP Rep. Ashley Hinson told “NBC Nightly News” that she is willing to stand up to Trump but is also standing by him as she runs for the Senate .
